response.justification: The candidate is a capable full-stack/web engineer with broad experience, but is a poor fit for this embedded networking security role. He lacks the mandatory native-level Japanese proficiency, has no demonstrated Linux kernel investigation or modification experience, no networking security background (MACsec, 802.1X, switch technologies), and only brief C/C++ exposure from a short stint in 2014-2015. His career trajectory centers on web platforms, TypeScript/Node.js, and DLang rather than embedded firmware development.
strengths: Broad, long-tenured software development experience (15+ years) across multiple stacks
Some low-latency systems experience (DLang async I/O, high-throughput microservices)
Strong engineering practices: TDD, CI/CD, open-source contributions, and teaching/mentoring
concerns: No Japanese language proficiency listed — a hard requirement for the role
Minimal C/UNIX and no Linux kernel, embedded firmware, or switch/networking experience
No exposure to required security technologies (MACsec, 802.1X, encryption, tamper detection)

key_factors.factor: General seniority and systems programming aptitude
